sbh1.2:1.5: yo gotrasthāna naṁ cā bhi dhyāyi yī tatprathamatastathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye śraddhāṁ pratilabhate |
sbh1.2:1.8: yo gotrasthastena vā tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye tatprathamataḥ śraddhā pratilabdhā bhavati |
sbh1.2:1.11: madhyakuśalamūlasamanvāgato gotrasthaḥ pudgalastatprathamatastathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye śraddhāṁ pratilabhya, yāvaddṛṣṭimṛjuṁ kṛtvā ekamvā kaṁ vā , dve vā, sambahulāni vā janmānyabhinirvarttayati |
sbh1.2:1.18: yaḥ pudgalaścaramamātmabhāvaṁ pratilabhyāsravakṣayāya samyagavavādānuśāsanīṁ, saddharmaśravaṇaṁ vā pratilabhya samyageva prayujyate |
sbh1.2:1.19: na cādhmāyi yī sarveṇa sarvaṁ sarvathā pratipadyate |
sbh1.2:2.1: tatra bhavyajātīyaḥ pudgalo gotraṁ niśritya, gotraṁ pratiṣṭhāya mṛdūni kuśalamūlāni pratilabhate |
sbh1.2:2.3: so a vatīrṇo mṛdūni kuśalamūlāni niśritya, pratiṣṭhāya, madhyāni kuśalamūlāni pratilabhatetaiścātmānamparipācayati |
sbh1.2:2.4: sa tathā paripacyamāno madhyāni kuśalamūlāni niśritya pratiṣṭhāyādhimātrāṇi kuśalamūlāni pratilabhate |
sbh1.2:2.9: strota āpattiphalamvā, sakṛdāgāmiphalaṁ vā a nāgāmiphalamvā sākṣātkaroti |
sbh1.2:3.1: saiṣā sādimadhyaparyavasānā sarvaśrāvakacaryā ṣaḍbhiḥ pudgalavyavasthānaiḥ sandarśitā bhavati |
sbh1.2:4.1: tatrāvatīrṇānāṁ pudgalānāṁ kiṁ parimāṇaniyatastulyaśca sarveṣāṁ kālo bhavati |
sbh1.2:4.4: na parinirvāṇāya āho naiṣāṁ parimāṇaniyataḥ kālo nāpi tulyaḥ sarveṣāmparinirvāṇāya |
sbh1.2:4.5: api tu yathāyogameṣāṁ yathāpratyayalābhaṁ parinirvāṇaṁ veditavyaṁ |
sbh1.2:4.6: keṣāṁciccireṇa, keṣāṁciccāticireṇa, keṣāṁcitpunaḥ kṣiprameva parinirvāṇaṁ bhavatyapi tu yo gotrasthaḥ pudgalaḥ sa sarvakṣipraṁ parinirvāti |
sbh1.2:4.7: so a vaśyaṁ trīṇi janmānyabhi nirvarttayati |
sbh1.2:4.15: iha gotrasthaḥ pudgalaḥ avatīrṇamātra eva yadā janmāntaraparivarttenāpi smṛtisaṁpramoṣaṁ pratilabhate |
sbh1.2:4.16: āśāstari dharmavinaye vā sati samvidyamāne a pi durākhyāte dharmavinaye svākhyāte a pyanekaparyāyeṇa durākhyātasya dharmavinayasya varṇaṁ stutimānuśansaṁ śaṁsaṁ śrutvā nāvatarati |
sbh1.2:4.18: pravrajito a pyavatīrṇo laghu laghveva pratyudāvarttakhe |
sbh1.2:4.20: madhuni jātasyeva ca prāṇakasya śuktiprakṣiptasya kāmopabhogino vā karde nde ṇa, syandanikāyāmvā prakṣiptasya yathāpi tatpūrvakeṇaiva hetubalādhānena svākhyātasya vā punardharmavinayasya naiva varṇa ṁ stutimānuśansaṁ śaṁsaṁ śrṛṇoti vā kaṇḍati vā |
sbh1.2:4.21: alpamātramavaramātramvā śrutvā, aśrutvā vā laghu laghvevāvatarati pravrajati vā |
sbh1.2:4.24: madhuprāṇakasya vā madhuni, kāmopabhogino vā praṇītāyāṁ kāmacaryāyāṁ |
sbh1.2:5.1: punaraparamavatīrṇaḥ pudgalaḥ lo na tāvadvisaṁyukto bhavatyapāyakṣaṇagamanīyaiḥ kleśaiḥ |
sbh1.2:6.1: sa yadā adhimātreṣu kuśalamūleṣu pratiṣṭho bhavatyanupūrveṇa paripākagamanīyeṣu tathā nākṣaṇeṣūpapadyate |
sbh1.2:6.4: punaraparamavatīrṇa ḥ pudgalaḥ buddhasya vā, dharmasya vā, saṁghasya vā guṇāṁcchrutvā, anusmṛtya vā, labhate cetasaḥ prasādamudāraṁ, kuśalaṁ, naiṣkrabhyopasaṁhitaṁ, bhūyo bhūyastenālambanena, prasādadravacittatayā astraprapātādromāṁcā dīni pratilabhate idaṁ tṛtīyamavatīrṇasya pudgalasya pudgalasya liṅgam |
sbh1.2:6.5: punaraparamavatīrṇaḥ pudgalaḥ prakṛtyaiva tīvreṇa hrīvyapatrāpyeṇa samanvāgato bhavati |
sbh1.2:6.6: yaduta sarvasāvaddyasthānasattā mu dācāreṣvidaṁ caturthamavatīrṇasya pudgalasya liṅgam |
sbh1.2:7.2: tīvracha ccha ndaḥ uddeśe, svādhyāye, paripṛcchāyāṁ, yoge, manasikāre, kiṁkuśalagaveṣī bhavati |
sbh1.2:8.1: punaraparamavatīrṇaḥ pudgalaḥ sarvakarmānteṣvanavadyeṣu sa rvasa mādāneṣu kuśalapakṣaprayogeṣu dṛḍhārambhaśca bhavati sthirārambhaśca niścitārambhaśca yaduta samāgamāya |
sbh1.2:9.1: punaraparamavatīrṇaḥ pudgalaḥ mandaraja ska jātīyo bhavati |
sbh1.2:9.3: na ca punaḥ prabandhaṁ sthāpayatyaśaṭhaśca bhavatyamāyāvī nihatamadamānāhaṁkāraguṇābhiniviṣṭo doṣadveṣṭā |
sbh1.2:13.3: madhyakuśalamūlasthitasya madhyāni, adhimātrakuśalamūlasthitasyādhimitrāṇi, nirantarāṇi, pariśuddhānīmānyucyante avatīrṇasya pudgalasya liṅgāni |
sbh1.2:13.4: yailiṁgaiḥ samanvāgata ḥ avatīrṇa iti saṁkhyāṁ gacchati |
sbh1.2:13.5: api punaretāni gotrasthānāmavatīrṇānāñca pudgalānāṁ ānumānikāni liṅgāni veditavyāni |
sbh1.2:13.6: buddhā eva tu bhagavantaḥ paramapārami tā prāptāśca śrāvakāstāyinaḥ |
sbh1.2:14.3: avatīrṇa eva, na paripacyamāno, na paripakvo, na niṣkrāntaḥ |
sbh1.2:15.2: asti niṣkrānto na paripakva eṣāṁ ca pūrvavadvibhāgo veditavyaḥ |
sbh1.2:16.1: ye a pi tadanye mṛdvindriyā dayaḥ pudgalāḥ |
sbh1.2:16.4: tatra yaścāyamavatārasya svabhāvaḥ, yacca vyavasthānaṁ, yāni cemānyavatīrṇānāṁ liṅgāni |
sbh1.2:18.1: svabhāvastad vyavasthānaṁ liṅgaṁ pudgala eva ca |
